pudge_meat_hook.d: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.

sh.d:
When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.

When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by 50%.

pudge_rot.d: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.

sc.d: Increases Rot radius by 200, damage by 90, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by 20%.

pudge_flesh_heap.d: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.

pudge_dismember.d: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of 75 units, up to a minimum of 125 range.

pudge_innate_graft_flesh.d: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining 2 bonus Strength for each stack.

lich_frost_nova.d: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for 4 seconds. The primary target receives both base and area damage.

lich_frost_shield.d: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every 1 seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.

lich_sinister_gaze.d: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.

sc.d: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of 400 in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

lich_chain_frost.d: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to 10 times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.

lich_death_charge.d:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.

sandking_burrowstrike.d:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

 Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.

sandking_sand_storm.d: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.

sandking_scorpion_strike.d: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of 125 take 40% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.

sandking_epicenter.d: After a cast point of 2 seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.

sc.d: When the pulses start, 3 Stinger attack areas are created every =0.5s at random locations, each measuring 35% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply =50% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause 1 attack(s).

sh.d: Increases Epicenter damage per pulse. Every 3.0s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.

sandking_caustic_finale.d: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.

crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.d: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.

crystal_maiden_frostbite.d: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals 4x damage to non-ancient creeps.

crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura.d:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a 1200 radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.

crystal_maiden_freezing_field.d: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with 100 random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts 10 seconds.

sc.d: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move 75% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by 20%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over 2s.

crystal_maiden_glacial_guard.d: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

zuus_arc_lightning.d: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.

zuus_lightning_bolt.d: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a 600 radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in 325 range.

zuus_heavenly_jump.d: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets 900 unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

zuus_thundergods_wrath.d: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.

zuus_static_field.d: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.

sven_storm_bolt.d: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.

sc.d: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional 180 damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.

sven_great_cleave.d: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.

sven_warcry.d: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts 8 seconds.

sh.d: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a %base_barrier_amount% physical damage barrier.

sven_gods_strength.d: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for 30 seconds.

sven_wrath_of_god.d: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.

lina_dragon_slave.d: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.

lina_light_strike_array.d: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.

lina_fiery_soul.d: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts 18 seconds.

lina_laguna_blade.d: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.

sh.d: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.

lina_slow_burn.d: Lina's abilities deal an additional 64% damage as burn damage over 4s.

axe_berserkers_call.d: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.

axe_battle_hunger.d: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.

sh.d: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.

axe_counter_helix.d: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.

sc.d: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.

axe_culling_blade.d:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.

axe_one_man_army.d: Axe gains Strength based on 50% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within 700 distance from Axe. The effect fades over 3s after approaching an ally.

juggernaut_blade_fury.d: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance and dealing damage every 0.2s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.

juggernaut_healing_ward.d: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health. The Healing Ward moves at 325 movement speed after being summoned. Lasts 18 seconds.

juggernaut_blade_dance.d: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.

juggernaut_omni_slash.d:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

juggernaut_bladeform.d: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every 2s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.

witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.d: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.

witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.d: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.

witch_doctor_maledict.d: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled units in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.

witch_doctor_death_ward.d: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of 8 seconds. Death Ward has 50% bonus accuracy.

sc.d: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.

witch_doctor_gris_gris.d:
Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, 100% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every 3s.

 Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

tidehunter_gush.d: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.

sc.d: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.

tidehunter_kraken_shell.d:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of 40% movement speed. Lasts 4s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

tidehunter_anchor_smash.d: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus 225 units.

tidehunter_ravage.d: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.

bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.d: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for 5 seconds. Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.

bristleback_quill_spray.d: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback. Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last 14 seconds.

bristleback_bristleback.d: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.

sc.d: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after 0.5s, forcefully ejects 5 sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every 0.4s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by -40%.

bristleback_warpath.d: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.

bristleback_prickly.d: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_pudge_1

scepter.d: Increases Rot radius by 200, damage by 90, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by 20%.

shard.d:
When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.

When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by 50%.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_lich_6

scepter.d: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of 400 in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

shard.d:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take 4 hero hits or 8 creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.

shard.d: Increases Epicenter damage per pulse. Every 3.0s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.

talents.n: +20% Glacial Guard Mana Spent To Barrier
talents.name: special_bonus_unique_crystal_maiden_glacial_guard_mana_multiplier

scepter.d: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move 75% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by 20%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over 2s.

shard.d: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.

scepter.d: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.

shard.d: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.

talents.n: -25% Storm Hammer Cooldown and Mana Cost
talents.name: special_bonus_unique_sven_stormhammer_cooldown

scepter.d: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional 180 damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.

shard.d: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a %base_barrier_amount% physical damage barrier.

talents.n: 5% Fiery Soul Magic Resist Per Stack
talents.name: special_bonus_unique_lina_4

talents.n: 150% Attack Crit On Targets Affected By Slow Burn
talents.name: special_bonus_unique_lina_crit_debuff

scepter.d: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.

shard.d: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.

talents.n: +3s Culling Blade Kill Buff Bonus Duration
talents.name: special_bonus_unique_axe_culling_blade_speed_duration

talents.n: +8% Movement Speed per active Battle Hunger
talents.name: special_bonus_unique_axe_8

scepter.d: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.

shard.d: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.

scepter.d: Performs a short Omnislash for 1 seconds.

talents.n: Maledict bursts deal 75% damage in a 800 AoE
talents.name: special_bonus_unique_witch_doctor_maledict_spread

talents.n: +1% Target Max Health Voodoo Restoration Heal
talents.name: special_bonus_unique_witch_doctor_2

scepter.d: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.

shard.d: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

talents.n: Kraken Shell Cleanse triggers Anchor Smash
talents.name: special_bonus_unique_tidehunter_smash_on_blubber

shard.d: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than 350 units away from the anchor forces the hero to 100 move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with 4 hero attacks.

scepter.d: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after 0.5s, forcefully ejects 5 sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every 0.4s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by -40%.

shard.d: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.
